en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large four‑storey corner building in a European city. The façade is richly ornamented in a late 19th‑century style. Printed captions at the bottom identify the intersection of two streets and note that the building houses a private gymnasium and boarding school run by Franz Scholz. On the right side there is handwritten German text in ink, and in the top right corner the city name and date are written. The left bottom corner bears a small printer's mark.
